song.author: Terry Macalmon
song.title: I Sing Praises to Your Name
song.lyrics:
[V1] . C D/C // I sing praises to Your Name, O Lord, . Bm Em7 Praises to Your Name, O Lord, . Am7 Dsus G Gsus G For Your Name is great and greatly to be praised. //
[V2] . C D/C // I give glory to Your Name, O Lord, . Bm Em7 Glory to Your Name, O Lord, . Am7 Dsus G Gsus G For Your Name is great and greatly to be praised. //
